summary: Treat blob/object URL creation and revocation as a host-managed URL store boundary.

semantics.create: returns a unique blob: URL associated with a host/object URL store
semantics.revoke: removes the mapping for future dereference
semantics.lifetime: host/global lifetime and Blob/File integration are observable

caveats: Object URL stores and lifetime are host concepts, not pure URL parsing.

tests.name: distinct calls produce distinct URLs
tests.input: const b=new Blob(["x"]); const a=URL.createObjectURL(b), c=URL.createObjectURL(b); console.log(a!==c); URL.revokeObjectURL(a); URL.revokeObjectURL(c);
